item.title: Nepal floods show the risk; China's mega-dam raises bigger questions for India
item.description: Recent Nepal floods highlight Himalayan vulnerabilities and cascading disaster risks. China's Yarlung Tsangpo dam project faces scrutiny due to its geologically unstable location. The dam's operation could influence downstream river flows and water security for India. Chinese scientists have warned about the project's seismic and landslide risks in the region. India faces managing combined risks from infrastructure, climate change, and border proximity.

item.title: Sooryavanshi faces another big test: his first five-day game in Duleep Trophy final
item.description: At just 15, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi is set to make his mark in the Duleep Trophy final, playing his inaugural five-day first-class match for East Zone. With a string of impressive achievements including record-breaking performances in the IPL and his international debut, this match will test his versatility and endurance, pushing him to adapt to the demands of longer cricket formats.

item.title: US immigration authority denies, revokes multiple H-1B petitions from major IT firm
item.description: USCIS denied and revoked multiple H-1B visa petitions from a major IT consulting company. The agency found skilled technology jobs were classified at lower wage levels than supported. This practice undercuts required wages and creates unfair competition for American workers. USCIS stated its action protects American workers and maintains program integrity. The immigration authority emphasized correct position classification under the H-1B system.

item.title: Canadian billionaire Kevin O’Leary says success requires sacrifice, focus and obsession
item.description: Kevin O'Leary emphasizes that reaching peak success requires immense dedication and sacrifice. He recommends that individuals focus on three to five key priorities while steering clear of distractions. Influential figures like Mark Cuban and Elon Musk echo similar sentiments, highlighting the role of sacrifice in amassing wealth. O'Leary cautions entrepreneurs to acknowledge failures swiftly, as pouring more resources into failing ideas rarely leads to redemption.

item.title: 1844 land grant still fuels Colorado's longest-running land dispute
item.description: The Cielo Vista Ranch in Colorado is at the centre of a land dispute dating to the 1844 Sangre de Cristo Land Grant. The 80,000-acre property has been the subject of decades of legal battles over access rights for land grant heirs. Governor Jared Polis has now appointed Ken Salazar as a special envoy to help the heirs, community and property owner find a way forward.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Jeff Bezos' ex-wife sets new record with donations to historically Black colleges
item.description: MacKenzie Scott has now donated over one billion dollars to historically Black colleges. Her recent forty-two million dollar gift to Elizabeth City State University marked this milestone. Scott has provided significant funding to numerous institutions since 2020. These unrestricted donations empower universities to allocate funds as needed. Her extensive philanthropic efforts support various educational and community initiatives.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: No single cause for MP child deaths: Centre
item.description: The inquiry into the illness affecting tribal children in Balaghat revealed various clinical factors behind their conditions. Officials noted that the deaths cannot be attributed to a single pathogen at this time. A total of 431 children received treatment, many of whom have since recovered. The administration has also supplied additional Measles-Rubella vaccines and purified water sources.
item.dc:creator: ANUJA JAISWAL

item.title: Tiger Woods and Vanessa Trump build wealth through brands and real estate
item.description: Vanessa Trump's wealth stems from family investments and real estate holdings. Tiger Woods built a diverse business empire through golf and various ventures. Woods' TGR Ventures oversees golf course design and sports entertainment projects. His portfolio includes fashion, hospitality, and technology investments. Both individuals have significant real estate assets contributing to their financial standing.
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: Travis Kelce grows business empire with $53m hydration deal
item.description: Travis Kelce expanded his growing business portfolio by joining organic hydration company Recover 180 as an investor and brand partner. The Kansas City Chiefs tight end highlighted the importance of quality hydration for peak performance and recovery. The move added to his partnerships across fashion, fitness, food and lifestyle brands. At the same time, Kelce remained focused on football, making it clear that winning another Super Bowl was his biggest goal.
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: Naomi Osaka vs Coco Gauff: Who has built more wealth in 2026?
item.description: Naomi Osaka and Coco Gauff are two of tennis’ most marketable stars in 2026, but they reached that status via different routes. Osaka has built a much wider business and branding empire alongside her Grand Slam career, and Gauff’s endorsement income and corporate interests have exploded in a short time; the pair’s combined net worth is a sign of the growing financial power of women’s tennis.

item.title: India crush Pakistan by 7 wickets after spin attack bundles them out for 55
item.description: In a stunning performance, India triumphed over Pakistan by seven wickets during their Group A encounter. Pakistan struggled significantly, managing a mere 55 runs, marking their lowest T20I score. India's spinners dominated, with Shree Charani leading the charge by taking three wickets. Shafali Verma made history by surpassing 3,000 T20I runs. With this victory, India completed the group stage undefeated and confidently secured a semi-final berth.

item.title: ‘Remarkable’: Ganguly’s special message for Shami ahead of 100th first-class game
item.description: Mohammed Shami will play his 100th first-class match in the Duleep Trophy final. Sourav Ganguly congratulated Shami on this significant career milestone. Ganguly highlighted the difficulty for subcontinent fast bowlers to sustain careers. Shami is currently aiming for an international recall after a strong domestic showing. His captain Ishan Kishan praised Shami's hunger and determination on the field.
item.dc:creator: HIJAM RAJU SINGH

item.title: ‘We’ve got to be careful’: Ex-CDS flags Pak's 'overconfidence' after Mecca Pact
item.description: Former CDS Gen Anil Chauhan warned Pakistan against overconfidence from a recent defense pact. He stated Pakistan will remain a significant security concern for India. Terrorism and proxy war are central to Pakistan's strategy towards India. Future warfare demands faster adaptation and integration across all domains. India must raise the cost of proxy war and terrorism for Pakistan.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: From Rs 60 a day to national award: Delhi teacher Suman Goel's 22-year journey
item.description: Suman Goel began teaching for just Rs 60 a day in 2004 to help fund her college education. Twenty-two years later, the former student of a Delhi government school has been selected for the National Teachers’ Award 2026. Now a primary teacher at the same school, Goel has focused on foundational learning, inclusion and student well-being, supporting children from disadvantaged backgrounds and students with special needs. Her journey highlights how personal struggles can shape an impactful teaching career.
item.dc:creator: TOI Education

item.title: Shafali scripts history, becomes fastest and youngest to reach 3,000 T20I runs
item.description: At just twenty-two years and 220 days old, Shafali Verma made history by becoming the youngest player ever to score 3,000 runs in T20 internationals. She also claimed the title for the fastest to reach this milestone in terms of balls faced. In a decisive match, India easily chased down Pakistan's meager total of fifty-six, securing a resounding seven-wicket victory.
item.dc:creator: NITESH DUBEY

item.title: Son loses gifted flat after neglecting parents; why he may still inherit it later
item.description: A recent Bombay High Court case involved a son who was directed to vacate his father’s flat after the court found that he had failed to honour the condition attached to the gift of the property. The flat had been transferred to him on the understanding that he would take care of his parents, an obligation he did not fulfil.

item.title: India’s spin chokehold leaves Pak in tatters: 55 all out is their lowest-ever total
item.description: Pakistan suffered their lowest T20I score ever, bowled out for just 55 runs. India's bowlers, led by Charani and Rawat, triggered a dramatic batting collapse. Pakistan lost six wickets for only eight runs after a promising start. This historic low occurred during Pakistan's 200th T20 International match. India continued their strong record against Pakistan.

item.title: ‘This isn’t politics’: Brian Lara backs Imran Khan, calls for dignity and proper care
item.description: Brian Lara and Pat Cummins join former captains supporting Imran Khan's treatment. They are calling for independent medical assessments and humane care. Concerns focus on Khan's reported vision problems while in custody. Khan denies corruption charges, which supporters claim are politically motivated. This appeal highlights basic humanity for a respected cricket legend.
item.dc:creator: HIJAM RAJU SINGH

item.title: Census 2027: The 14 questions and why opposition fears an NPR 'backdoor'
item.description: Enumerators have begun the decennial headcount in Ladakh and snowbound regions. New questions in the Census questionnaire have raised opposition concerns about its purpose. Critics allege the Census is becoming a backdoor for the National Population Register. The Census Act legally protects personal information collected during the exercise. Experts debate the data's use and potential privacy implications.

item.title: Watch: US strikes 3 Iranian oil tankers after Iran targets 2 navy warships
item.description: In a tense confrontation, US forces targeted three Iranian oil tankers after missile strikes on Navy warships. The vessels successfully dodged multiple Iranian attacks without any injuries reported. Serving as financial support for Iran's Revolutionary Guard and proxies, one tanker was rendered useless near Kharg Island, while another faced destruction close to Jask, with the last one obliterated in the Gulf of Oman as its crew evacuated.
item.dc:creator: ARYAN SINGH

item.title: Putin orders 3-day pause in strikes on Kyiv as US delegation arrives in Russia
item.description: US special representatives Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner arrived in Moscow for crucial peace talks. President Putin ordered a three-day halt to strikes on Kyiv for the American delegation's visit. Both Russia and Ukraine had intensified long-range attacks before this diplomatic engagement. The US push aims to revive efforts to end the ongoing conflict between the nations. The envoys will travel to Ukraine after concluding their discussions in Russia.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: Harmanpreet creates history, becomes first cricketer ever to captain in 150 T20Is
item.description: In a remarkable achievement, Harmanpreet Kaur captained her 150th T20I match during the Women's Asia Cup against Pakistan, solidifying her status as a leading figure in women's cricket. Her focus remains on enjoying the sport rather than tallying numbers, and this milestone places her ahead of many celebrated male captains in T20I history.
item.dc:creator: NITESH DUBEY

item.title: A home run for workers? Daman & Diu’s SPARSH 2.0 opens more rental space
item.description: The SPARSH 2.0 initiative is designed to stimulate the development of affordable rental housing by offering developers enticing incentives such as increased floor space index and enhanced ground coverage options. To qualify, developments must dedicate sixty-six percent of their units to economically weaker sections, promoting worker welfare and increasing industrial productivity. This initiative will be in effect across Daman, Dadra and Nagar Haveli, and Diu until 2027.
item.dc:creator: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK

item.title: ‘Don’t give me these useless jumlas’: Kangana pulls up officials over unused funds
item.description: BJP MP Kangana Ranaut expressed anger over delayed development works. She questioned the utilization of nearly eleven crore rupees allocated for projects. Officials had repeatedly assured her that funds were being used effectively. However, external surveys revealed a different and concerning reality on the ground. Ranaut demanded immediate completion of pending works and accountability from officials.
item.dc:creator: ANJALI SINGH

item.title: At least 22 killed in fire at wedding party in Congo’s Kinshasa
item.description: A devastating fire at a wedding party in Kinshasa claimed at least twenty-two lives. The blaze erupted overnight Friday and continued into Saturday morning in the Lingwala district. Many people were injured as they attempted to escape the rapidly spreading flames. Narrow hallways caused congestion, hindering escape efforts for those trapped inside. The exact cause of the tragic fire remains unconfirmed by authorities.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: ‘No handshake’ again: Harmanpreet, Fatima avoid customary gesture at Asia Cup toss
item.description: The long-standing no-handshake tradition persisted between the captains of India and Pakistan during the Asia Cup match. In Dubai, Fatima Sana won the toss and elected to bat first. Notably, Harmanpreet Kaur marked her 150th T20I match as captain. With both teams already in the semi-finals, India's aim remains to uphold their dominance over Pakistan.
item.dc:creator: HIJAM RAJU SINGH

item.title: Raina’s blueprint for India: Backs Abhishek for Test, calls Pant white-ball 'X-factor'
item.description: Suresh Raina expressed confidence in Abhishek Sharma's potential to succeed in Test cricket. He also highlighted Rishabh Pant as an impressive asset in white-ball formats. Notably, Pant has become a pivotal figure in India's red-ball squad. Raina's insights on fostering player development and promoting Test cricket engagement were shared during an interview on Aakash Chopra's YouTube channel.
item.dc:creator: NITESH DUBEY

item.title: Where have all the buyers gone? DC homes lose value as demand dries up
item.description: In Washington, the housing market is revealing an intriguing dynamic, with many properties available at discounted rates—almost one-fifth of homes listed currently are priced lower than what they were purchased for initially. This development points to a slump in buyer interest instead of a surplus of homes for sale. Luxury regions may see upward price trajectories, yet affordable condos are struggling.
item.dc:creator: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
